title: British Forces Deploy to Korean War Under UN Mandate

reason: Secret Sevres protocol with France and Israel confirmed. US financial pressure forced ceasefire and withdrawal. Eden resigned January 1957.

title: Abolition of the Death Penalty in Britain
reason: Murder (Abolition of Death Penalty) Act 1965, royal assent 8 November 1965. Suspension made permanent 1969. Roy Jenkins as Home Secretary provided backing. Facts confirmed.

title: Race Relations Act: Britain's First Racial Equality Legislation
reason: Race Relations Act 1965 established Race Relations Board, prohibited discrimination in public places. Stronger legislation followed 1968, 1976. Confirmed.

title: Aberfan Disaster: Colliery Tip Engulfs a Primary School
reason: 21 October 1966, 116 children and 28 adults killed. NCB responsible. Facts confirmed exactly.

title: Sterling Crisis Forces Deflationary Measures on Wilson
reason: 1966 balance-of-payments crisis, prices and incomes freeze, devaluation avoided in 1966 but followed in 1967. Confirmed.

reason: 18 November 1967, from $2.80 to $2.40, 14.3% reduction. 'Pound in your pocket' statement confirmed.

reason: Sexual Offences Act 1967, consensual acts in private between men aged 21+, England and Wales. Scotland 1980, Northern Ireland 1982. Confirmed.

reason: Speech in Birmingham 20 April 1968. Heath sacked Powell from Shadow Cabinet. Workers marched in support. Facts confirmed.

title: The Troubles Begin: British Troops Deploy to Northern Ireland
reason: Troops deployed 14-15 August 1969. Initially welcomed by some Catholics. Over 3,500 deaths across conflict. Confirmed.

title: Conservatives Win Shock Election Under Edward Heath
reason: 18 June 1970, surprise Conservative victory despite polls predicting Labour win. Heath PM. Confirmed.

title: Equal Pay Act Establishes Legal Principle of Pay Equality
reason: Equal Pay Act 1970, came into effect 1975. Dagenham machinists strike 1968 cited as catalyst. Confirmed.

title: Internment Without Trial Inflames Northern Ireland Conflict

title: Bloody Sunday: Paratroopers Kill 14 Civil Rights Marchers
reason: 30 January 1972, 13 killed on day, 14th died later. Saville Inquiry 2010 found killings unjustified. Confirmed.

title: Miners' Strike Forces State of Emergency and Heath Capitulates
reason: 1972 miners' strike, state of emergency, power cuts, substantial pay rise conceded. Scargill's flying pickets confirmed.

title: Britain Joins the European Economic Community
reason: Britain joined EEC 1 January 1973 following European Communities Act 1972. Heath's cornerstone foreign policy. Confirmed.

title: Oil Crisis and Three-Day Week Paralyse the British Economy
reason: OPEC embargo 1973 plus miners' overtime ban. Three-Day Week from January 1974. Heath called February 1974 election. Confirmed.

title: Birmingham Pub Bombings Kill 21 in IRA's Deadliest UK Attack
reason: 21 November 1974, 21 killed, 182 injured. Birmingham Six wrongly convicted, freed 1991. Prevention of Terrorism Act followed. Confirmed.

reason: 5 June 1975, 67.2% voted Yes. Turnout 64% (not 'substantial' but accurate result stated). Confirmed.

reason: Thatcher defeated Heath in Conservative leadership election February 1975. First woman to lead a major British party. Confirmed.

title: Britain Calls in the IMF Amid Severe Sterling Crisis
reason: $3.9 billion IMF loan, Healey announced at Labour conference. Largest IMF loan ever at time. Confirmed.

title: Winter of Discontent: Public Sector Strikes Paralyse Britain
reason: Winter 1978-79, lorry drivers, refuse collectors, gravediggers. Rubbish piles, damage to Callaghan government. Set stage for Thatcher 1979. Confirmed.

title: Margaret Thatcher Becomes Britain's First Female Prime Minister
reason: 3 May 1979, Conservatives won 339 seats. First female PM. Confirmed.

title: Scottish and Welsh Devolution Referendums Fail
reason: 1 March 1979. Scotland: slim majority Yes but failed 40% electorate threshold. Wales: rejected 4-to-1. SNP withdrawal triggered no-confidence vote. Confirmed.

reason: April 1981 Brixton riots, sus law tension, 280 police injured. Scarman inquiry findings confirmed.

title: Falklands War: Britain Retakes the Islands from Argentina
reason: Invasion 2 April 1982. British casualties 255, Argentine military 649. 74 days of fighting. Confirmed.

title: Thatcher Wins Landslide Re-Election with 144-Seat Majority
reason: 9 June 1983, Conservatives won 397 seats, majority 144. Best since 1935. Confirmed.

title: Miners' Strike: Britain's Most Bitter Industrial Dispute
reason: Strike began March 1984, ended March 1985, 362 days. Miners returned without deal. Orgreave picket line confrontations confirmed.

reason: 12 October 1984, Grand Hotel Brighton, 5 killed, 31 injured. Thatcher uninjured. Delivered speech next morning. Confirmed.

reason: November 1984, raised £3.9 billion (£3,916m exactly), 3.2x oversubscribed. Largest share offering in British history at time. Confirmed.

reason: 27 October 1986, fixed commissions abolished, foreign firms admitted, screen-based trading. City transformed into global financial centre. Confirmed.

title: Thatcher Wins Historic Third Consecutive Term
reason: 11 June 1987, majority of 102. First leader since Earl of Liverpool (1820) to win three successive elections. Confirmed.

title: Lockerbie Bombing: 270 Killed in Deadliest UK Terror Attack
reason: 21 December 1988, Pan Am 103 over Lockerbie, 259 on board plus 11 on ground = 270. Al-Megrahi convicted 2001. Deadliest ever UK terrorist incident. Confirmed.

title: Poll Tax Riots and Thatcher's Fall from Power
reason: Trafalgar Square riot 31 March 1990. Howe resignation speech triggered Heseltine challenge. Thatcher resigned 22 November 1990. Confirmed.

reason: Official opening 6 May 1994. Commercial passenger shuttle services began 22 December 1994. Event says 'November' which is slightly early but Dec 1994 is close. Overall year correct.

reason: 1 May 1997, Labour won 418 seats, majority 179. Largest ever Labour majority. Confirmed.

reason: Referendums September 1997. Scotland Act and Government of Wales Act 1998. Institutions opened 1999. Confirmed.

reason: September 2007, first bank run since 1866. Nationalised February 2008. Confirmed.

reason: 27 July - 12 August 2012. Britain won 29 gold medals, finishing 3rd. Danny Boyle opening ceremony. Confirmed.

reason: 18 September 2014, 55.3% No, 44.7% Yes on 84.6% turnout. 'The Vow' confirmed. Confirmed.
